label: first input token is z (t=0)
explanation: Fires exactly when the very first original token (t=0) is the letter z, with constant magnitude (1.223, effectively binary). Does not fire on z at any later position (t>0 in original or copy phase), on any other first token, or on the delimiter. One stray weak activation (0.065) in the copy phase on z input after <DEL> in a single dev sequence.

issues: Saying 'all four metrics were 1.000' on test is rounding. The exact test scores are precision 1.0, recall 0.99994, F1 0.99997 and mass recall 0.999996. There is one missed activation: a weak 0.07 on a copied z at t=4, right after <DEL>, in an L=3 sequence (z a c <DEL> z a). It is the same kind of case as the one dev exception, but it is 1 step out of about 16.7k with about 0% of the activation mass, so it is noise and does not form a pattern.

The test split has no false positives. The magnitude is constant at 1.223, which confirms the on/off claim. The feature never fires on the delimiter and fires once in the copy phase, which matches the explanation.
